vulnerability_type: Owner Privilege Abuse - Excessive Fee Setting

preconditions.description: Attacker must be contract owner or authorized address to call setFees()
Trading must be enabled (tradingOpen = true) for transfers to occur
Contract must have token balance to trigger swapBack and fee collection

exploit_hint: 1. Call setFeeReceivers() to set marketingFeeReceiver to attacker address. 2. Call setFees() with excessive fee values (e.g., _marketingdevelopmentFee = 9000, _feeDenominator = 10000 for 90% fees). 3. Trigger token transfers (buy/sell) to accumulate fees in contract. 4. Fees are converted to BNB during swapBack() and sent to marketingFeeReceiver. 5. Attacker receives excessive BNB from user transfers through the marketing fee mechanism.
